title: 'Entitled' Woman Busted For Doing THIS in Upscale Neighborhood
description:
Neighbors in an upscale New Jersey neighborhood blew up 911 after spotting someone pulling on car door handles in the early hours of June 6, 2023. Holmdel police confronted Shadi Khorram after interviewing multiple witnesses and reviewing doorbell video of the scene. Khorram was identified in several videos as the woman accused of breaking into cars. She denied the accusations and continued to cry as she was processed at the police station. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
